rationale: Scoped default within grouped CUDA DF-CBS Fast force calls; Standard, energy-only, standalone and supplied-problem defaults remain off. Auxiliary-only FP32 Lambda preconvergence borrows idle shared strict scratch. Fast compensates the owner's Q-cap halving to preserve the ordinary Q32 ceiling subject to bounded admission. FP64 primal/core/RHS/Krylov algebra and individual-Q widening remain intact. Only a finite proposal crosses a permanent precision boundary into a new FP64 GMRES solve with a fresh physical action and empty history. Independent expanded FP64 audit and every parameter/factor/force VJP retain the selected Fast physical limits; optional resource refusal retains bounded FP64 actions and nonfinite failures do not publish or silently retry. Native telemetry distinguishes requests from executed work. Repeated matched C4 endpoints, larger C1-C7 controls and independent C2/water force checks qualify this consumer, not a universal precision/performance policy.
revisit_condition: Broaden beyond the qualified CBS Fast consumer only with source-matched complete endpoint, independent numerical and additional-device evidence. Preserve total mixed-plus-strict work accounting, bounded refusal and lifetime contracts. Revisit the requested cap if shared scratch planning changes; borrowed capacity is not a measured allocator peak and all warmup work belongs in endpoint time.
